original.statement: Cilium CLI must be upgraded to v0.15.0 or later and switched to Helm installation mode to install and manage Cilium v1.16; classic installation mode is no longer supported, and migrating from classic to Helm mode requires uninstalling with classic mode CLI and reinstalling with Helm mode CLI.

decision.reason: The evidence [ev-f2e613944dc4] says to "Upgrade Cilium CLI to v0.15.0 or later" in order to install and manage Cilium v1.16. That is a new minimum version for a separately versioned companion tool, so a product-relationship on cilium-cli with requirement-changed after ">=0.15.0" matches the text exactly. The classic-to-Helm uninstall/reinstall step in the same passage is a separate migration aspect. It does not make this version-requirement reading wrong.
